title: When Weak Intent Becomes a Requirement: replication package
description: Replication package for a study of whether large language models preserve the modal force of requirements when extracting them, whether lightweight uncertainty signals expose strengthening of weak stakeholder intent, and whether output-based checks detect it. Contains the frozen prompts, the benchmark, the campaign configuration, the analysis code, the paper tables with provenance, and the figures. Raw model outputs are archived in a separate Zenodo dataset record.
